messages:
marta: Quick sync — we've been seeing flaky admits for quantized RTX variants. I think the golden sample selection is biased toward mid-length prompts and misses tail failure modes. Proposing a delta-based golden set stratification by seq_len bins. Thoughts?

ashwin: Can you sketch the delta-based idea? we currently pick top-N seeds by perplexity coverage.

marta: Sketch: run candidate vs baseline (fp16) on a large pool; compute per-input delta metric (e.g., change in token log-probs or normalized edit distance). Instead of global top-N, pick samples that maximize delta diversity across length bins (0-32,33-128,129-512,513-2k,2k+). That should surface regressions that only appear at long sequences.

liam: Risk: this blows up bench cost. How many samples per bin are you thinking?

marta: Target ~200 samples/bin -> ~1k per model. Still much cheaper than a full eval suite and more likely to catch quantization artifacts. We can reduce bins or sample counts if infra cost is a blocker.

sophia: Also need to account for nondeterminism: sampling temperature / seeds can produce noise in deltas. Add a deterministic run variant (seed+greedy) to compute the delta baseline, then run stochastic checks only on flagged inputs.

ashwin: Good call. bench-harness already supports --seed and --deterministic flags. We can add a --delta-threshold param and a --bins arg. Example command: `bench-run --model candidate --baseline fp16 --bins 5 --samples-per-bin 200 --deterministic --delta-threshold 0.02`

jun: Don't forget KV-cache parity. Quantized runtime occasionally changes memory writes leading to off-by-one logits after long histories. We should add a lightweight kv-smoke probe that replays short to medium histories and compares final logits within epsilon.

marta: Plan: 1) delta-based stratified selection to choose golden seeds; 2) deterministic delta pass; 3) kv-smoke probe for sequences > 512 tokens; 4) stochastic stress on flagged seeds.

rachel: Edgecase: models with chunked attention (sliding-window) will naturally diverge on very long sequences unless we compare using chunk-aware execution. Need a model attribute `execution.chunking=true` so compare against a chunked baseline or ignore certain mismatches.

liam: Operational tradeoff: we add model metadata (chunking, kv-layout-version) and bench flags; that increases onboarding friction. How do we keep the UX simple for new model owners?

marta: Default flow should be zero-config: run the stratified delta with conservative defaults (5 bins, 100 samples/bin) and auto-detect chunking by probing long-seq behavior. Only ask owners to set metadata when auto-detect fails.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Ticket INF-4232 created: "estimate infra cost for delta-stratified golden selection" (assignee: eng-ml). :spiral_calendar:

ashwin: We'll need a small dashboard change to show per-bin delta histograms and a flag list of inputs that triggered kv-smoke failures. That will help triage.

marta: I'll draft a short RFC follow-up with default params, an example bench-run command, and a tiny script to pick per-bin seeds. If no objections by EOD I'll open a PR to add the args and the kv-smoke probe.

liam: +1 from me. Let's make the delta metric pluggable (logprob delta, token-edit, rouge) so different product teams can pick what matters.

marta: Agreed. I'll include plug-in points in the RFC. Thanks everyone.
